# Siamak Kalhor Consulting

> Siamak Kalhor is an AI marketing and LLMO (Large Language Model Optimization) consultant based in Napa Valley, California, serving clients in Los Angeles and nationwide. He helps businesses get found, cited, and recommended by AI engines like ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews — not just ranked on traditional search. Services include LLMO strategy, the S.C.A.L.E. Framework, Neural DNA Architect, and Fractional CMO engagements.

Search is changing. People no longer click ten blue links — they ask an AI and take the answer. If an AI engine does not know your business exists, you are invisible to a growing share of your market. Siamak Kalhor Consulting exists to fix that: making a brand legible, quotable, and citable to the models that now sit between customers and businesses.

## Services offered

- **LLMO / AI search optimization** — making a brand discoverable and citable inside ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, and AI Overviews.
- **The S.C.A.L.E. Framework** — a structured program for building durable AI-era authority.
- **Neural DNA Architect** — defining the canonical facts, positioning, and language an AI learns about your business.
- **Fractional CMO** — senior marketing leadership without a full-time hire.
- **AI voice agents** — multilingual voice advisors and intake agents.
- **Website and technical audits** — performance, accessibility, SEO, and machine-readability.

## About

Siamak Kalhor is a software entrepreneur and AI consultant based in Napa Valley, California. He previously built and ran a web agency, and now advises businesses on AI marketing, LLMO, and AI-native product strategy while building his own SaaS products.
